expectations.text: Plan follows all 6 steps of the checklist (not lightweight subset)
expectations.evidence: Plan has 7 numbered sections covering CLAUDE.md, Obsidian vault, Index.md, related notes, verification, Notion, and summary. Covers equivalent scope to the 6-step checklist.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md changelog includes rows for all new files created
expectations.evidence: Section 1 includes 11 changelog rows covering design docs, engine module, component, GameView wiring, integration tests, GameView tests, component tests, Obsidian vault, and CLAUDE.md update.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md project status is updated with Phase 6G completion
expectations.evidence: Section 2 updates project status with Phase 6G line, current phase, and engine stats (67→69 modules, 1027→1051 tests).

expectations.text: Creates Obsidian system note using obsidian_append_content
expectations.evidence: Section 3 says 'Tool: Determined by Obsidian MCP tool availability' and suggests placing file in 'Locations/' folder. Does not explicitly use obsidian_append_content — suggests generic 'Edit via Obsidian MCP' and filesystem paths. Uncertain approach.

expectations.text: Updates Index.md using obsidian_append_content (NOT obsidian_patch_content on headings)
expectations.evidence: Section 4 says 'Tool: Edit via Obsidian MCP (or Edit tool if accessing as plain text file)' — does NOT specify obsidian_append_content. Suggests using filesystem Edit tool or generic MCP, and proposes referencing 'Locations/Location Detail Panel.md' path (wrong folder). No awareness of the heading workaround.

expectations.text: Fetches Notion page before attempting any updates
expectations.evidence: Section 7 starts with notion-fetch call to the Development Backlog URL before any updates.

expectations.text: Includes git commit step with Co-Authored-By footer
expectations.evidence: No git commit step included in the plan. The plan ends with Notion updates. No Step 6 equivalent for committing changes.

expectations.text: Correctly places new system note in Systems/ folder
expectations.evidence: Section 3 explicitly recommends 'Locations/' folder: 'Recommended Path: /sessions/gracious-elegant-planck/mnt/TheFantasyWorldSimulator/Locations/Location Detail Panel.md'. This is incorrect — system notes go in Systems/.

suggestions.reason: The without-skill baseline also attempts to update 3 related Obsidian notes (Hex Zoom View.md, Location View.md, View Levels.md) which is over-documenting and would likely fail with obsidian_patch_content on headings.

eval_feedback.overall: Clear quality difference — baseline lacks API workaround knowledge and folder conventions.
